title: Executive Overview
description: Monthly-cadence business-health glance: is the product working, and what does it cost. Not a debugging tool -- see the Engineering/Applications folder for that. docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-13-sre-dashboard-strategy-design.md.

panels.title: Error-free rate, /query + /auth (cumulative)
panels.description: 100 * (1 - sum(openlex_http_requests_total{route=~"/query|/auth.*",status_class="5xx"}) / sum(openlex_http_requests_total{route=~"/query|/auth.*"})) -- against the 99% SLO target from the production observability design doc. Raw cumulative counters (not increase(...[30d])): increase() is blind to a labeled counter's first sample, and 6h Prometheus retention can't feed a 30d window -- so the ratio is computed over the counters' full life since the api pods started.

panels.title: Estimated Anthropic cost (cumulative)
panels.description: sum(openlex_anthropic_cost_usd_total) -- cumulative since the api pods started, from the static pricing table in legal_generation.anthropic_metrics (not a live billing API). Uses the raw counter, NOT increase(...[30d]): a prometheus_client labeled counter's series only appears AFTER its first increment, so increase() never sees the initial 0->cost edge and reads $0 after the very first query; with 6h Prometheus retention a 30d window also empties once traffic ages out. The raw counter shows cost from the first query and is reset-tolerant enough for the demo.

panels.title: p95 latency, /query (cumulative)
panels.description: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (openlex_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/query"})) -- p95 over all /query requests since the api pods started. Uses the raw cumulative buckets, not rate(...[30d]): rate/increase is blind to a histogram's first observation and 6h retention can't feed a 30d window, so a windowed p95 reads empty after the first query or once traffic ages out.

panels.title: Query volume trend (last 6h)
panels.description: sum(rate(openlex_query_requests_total[1d])) * 86400 -- accepted queries/day. This is a trend (not a cumulative tile), so it needs a time window: the dashboard defaults to the last 6h to match Prometheus retention here (a 30d axis would render a mostly-empty sliver).

panels.title: Tier mix (cumulative)
panels.description: sum by (tier) (openlex_query_requests_total) -- share of accepted queries by silver/gold/platinum since the api pods started. Raw counter, not increase(...[30d]), so a tier appears from its first query and doesn't age out with 6h retention.
